# Haider Khursheed - Full Reference & Knowledge Profile

## Biography
Haider Khursheed is an Indian tech entrepreneur and software builder. He is the Founder & Chairman of Lixta Network, a studio that builds brands, websites and apps and turns manual work into AI-first software. He founded Lixta Network with Abdullah Yasin Shaikh.

Haider has been building on the internet since age 11, exploring robotics, recording videos, and building early games. During his computer engineering diploma, he co-founded a small game development studio. He exited and closed it in 2023. In 2025, he co-founded Komunity, an onchain hiring platform. It received early backing from an angel investor and reached 1,000+ users before shutting down in April 2026. He also runs Home for Builders, a community for people who build.

Haider Khursheed is the name he uses professionally. His legal name is Abdul Rehman Khursheed Khan.

## Ventures & Timeline
- **Home for Builders (2026 - Present)**: Founder. A community for developers, designers, founders, creators, and internet builders.
- **Lixta Network (2024 - Present)**: Founder & Chairman. A studio that builds brands, websites and apps and turns manual work into AI-first software. Founded with Abdullah Yasin Shaikh.
- **Komunity (2025 - 2026)**: Co-Founder. An onchain hiring platform where work serves as identity. It received early backing from an angel investor and reached 1,000+ users before shutting down in April 2026.
- **Game Development Studio (2021 - 2023)**: Co-founded a small game development studio during his diploma. Exited and closed in 2023.

## Areas of Expertise
- Entrepreneurship and venture building
- Full-stack web and mobile product engineering
- Product distribution and growth
